common: Production sprite animation source atlas for our browser game. An original rich 16-bit pixel-art interpretation of the ACTUAL Plants vs Zombies cactus shown in reference1; reference2 supplies our approved stepped pixel contours, saturated dimensional material shading, crisp dark navy outline and pale cream background. Exact FIVE columns by THREE rows, FIFTEEN complete separated full-character poses in equal square cells, consistent scale and design. Whole plant and spines fit with generous margins. No text, labels, cell borders, ground, shadows, detached particles or projectiles. Every pose faces RIGHT in consistent three-quarter side view. Canonical cactus identity: vertical bright green ribbed cactus column, TWO natural raised branching cactus lobes, tan/reddish-brown clusters of long spines, short forward tubular snout with dark bore, narrow pale eyes under MAD slanted dark brows, ruffled pink-coral flower crown, low brown stone/soil ring base. These branches are cactus anatomy, never hands or human arms; no legs, feet, shoes or green leaf pedestal. MAD at every stage and action, cute but determined, no smile. Reading order frames: 1 idle A;2idle B slight rib compression;3walk1 lean right with base rock;4walk2 straighten tall;5walk3 lean left while snout remains right;6walk4 settle compressed.7attack windup snout compresses/backward lean;8attack release snout thrusts forward and widens, cactus branches flare;9attack recovery recenter with snout smaller.10hurt flinch eyes squeezed with angry brows.11knockedOut1 column droops bent over base, eyes CLOSED;12knockedOut2 head/column rests lower over stones, eyes CLOSED, no snapped pieces.13cheer1 proud tall rise and branches lift while MAD brows stay;14cheer2 taller proud stretch and branch tips angled wider, not human gestures;15SLEEP eyes completely CLOSED and body gently drooped, mad brow shapes retained. Sleep and KO MUST show closed eyelids, no pupils. Strong drawn articulation between frames, no still-image duplicates. Plant always remains attached to stone base; no rotation offscreen.

variants.desc: Basic CACTUS: one compact ribbed upright column with exactly two curved side cactus branches and one ruffled PINK-CORAL flower with three gold stamens on crown. Clear but restrained tan spine clusters. This is stage0, keep relatively simple and slender, no armor/crown/necklace.

PRICKLY CACTUS: stage1 natural evolution of actual cactus. Taller, thicker ribbed upright column, two larger curved cactus side branches with denser long tan needle clusters and TWO ruffled pink-coral blooms at crown. Same characteristic angry pale eyes and right-facing tube. Additional vertical rib shading and rib grooves. Organic cactus anatomy, not a robot or humanoid.

SPIKE CACTUS: final stage2 natural evolution, impressive tall broad upright cactus with extra pronounced deep ribs, two thick raised cactus branches, dense fans of LONG tan spines along branches/torso and THREE ruffled pink-coral flowers crowning top. Keep silhouette readable rather than a tangled needle ball. Same narrow mad pale eyes and forward tubular snout. No unrelated armor, literal royal crown, limbs or feet. Natural expanded cactus.
